content: Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, kytzaqpinkjtzinjiꞌy tkyaqiljo nya bꞌaꞌn, ex jniꞌ sbꞌuꞌbꞌl, junx tukꞌa xmiletzꞌil, exsin loꞌchj kꞌuꞌjbꞌaj ex tkyaqil iqj yol.
Ex chi okxa tzeꞌnku jun neꞌẍ n-oqꞌ tiꞌj tmiꞌẍ, tuꞌn tchꞌiy. Ikytzintla kyejiꞌy kyjyomtzinjiꞌy Tyol Dios, a tzꞌaqle, tuꞌntzintla kychꞌiya tiꞌjjo t-xilin kolbꞌil,
quꞌn ma kynikyꞌbꞌiy qa ate qAjaw tbꞌanilxix.
Jesús, a Abꞌj itzꞌxix, tuꞌn tchꞌiy Ttanim tibꞌaj
Chi laqꞌetza tkꞌatz qAjaw, a Abꞌj itzꞌxix, a s-el kyiꞌjlinxjal, nyakuj ntiꞌ tajbꞌin toj kywutz, me tbꞌanilx twutz qMan Dios, ex skꞌoꞌnxix tuꞌn.

Ikyqetzin kyejiꞌy tzeꞌnku abꞌj itzꞌ, kyjaꞌ kyjaw chꞌiysiꞌn tuꞌn kyoka te tja qMan, a bꞌinchin tuꞌn Xewbꞌaj Xjan; ex tuꞌn kyoka te jun chꞌuq pale xjanxix, tuꞌn kyxi kyqꞌoꞌn oyaj tukꞌa tkyaqil kyanmiꞌn, a ntzalaj qMan Dios kyiꞌj, noq tuꞌn Jesucrist.
Quꞌn ikytziꞌn ntqꞌmaꞌn Dios toj Tuꞌjil Tyol kyjaluꞌn:

content.text: Kꞌwel nqꞌonjiꞌy Abꞌj toj tnam Sion,
a nimxix toklin te tqꞌuqiljo ja.
Atzin Abꞌj lo, skꞌoꞌnxix wuꞌn ex tbꞌanilxix.
Alkyejo knimil tiꞌj, nlay tzꞌel toj txꞌixewch.

content: Atzin jaꞌlin, ayiꞌy, a ma chi nimiꞌn tiꞌj, atzin Abꞌjjo tbꞌanilxix, me ankye qe, a mi chi nimin tiꞌj, kchi okil tzeꞌnku ntqꞌmaꞌn toj Tuꞌjil Tyol Dios:

content.text: Atzin Abꞌj, a s-el kyiꞌjlin bꞌinchil ja, ma tzꞌok te nimxix toklin te tqꞌuqil tẍkyin,
ex ma tzꞌok te jun Abꞌj te toljsbꞌil, ex tuꞌn kyjaw takpajxjal tiꞌj.

content: Ex kchi jawil toljxjal tiꞌj, tzeꞌnku t-xim Dios, quꞌn mi xi kynimin Tbꞌanil Tqanil.
Aye nimil etzinqe tuꞌn qMan Dios

Me metzin kyeꞌ ma chi oka te jun tyajil skꞌoꞌnxix tuꞌn Dios, a Nmaq Kawil toj kyaꞌj, ex te pale tuꞌn tajbꞌin te, ex te jun chꞌuq xjal xjanxix, ex te jun tnam, a teku Dios, tuꞌntzintla t-xi kyqꞌmaꞌnjiꞌy a tbꞌanil t-xilin Dios, a xtxkon kyeꞌy tuꞌn kyetza tojjo tqxopinil il, tuꞌn kyokxa tojjo tspikyꞌemil te jun majx.
Quꞌn ojtxe, ntiꞌtaq kymujbꞌil kyibꞌa, me atzin jaꞌlin, ma chi oka te Ttanim Dios. Ex ojtxe, naꞌmtaq tuꞌn tyekꞌin te Dios tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil tkꞌuꞌj kyiꞌja, me atzin jaꞌlin ma tzaj qꞌaqꞌin tkꞌuꞌj kyiꞌja.
Chi bꞌet-xixa toj tumil, tuꞌn kyajbꞌiꞌn te Dios

Ayiꞌy werman, nimx nkꞌuꞌja kyiꞌja, ayiꞌy nyakuj bꞌetin xjalqiꞌy tzaluꞌn twutz txꞌotxꞌ. Nchin kubꞌsin nwutza kyeꞌy, tuꞌn tkubꞌ kytzyuꞌn kyibꞌa tiꞌjjo kyachbꞌila, a nya wen, a nchi qꞌojin tiꞌj kyanmiꞌn.

Ex chi bꞌet-xa toj tumil kyxoljo nya nimil. Ikytziꞌn, exla qa nchi yolbꞌin kyiꞌja, a nyakuj aj ilqiꞌy, me k-okil kykaꞌyin ajo kybꞌinchbꞌiꞌn wen, ex kchi nimsil tbꞌi qMan Dios, aj tpon qꞌij tuꞌn kynimin.
Kyniminqekujiꞌy tkyaqil kawbꞌil tzaluꞌn twutz txꞌotxꞌ, quꞌn tuꞌn nimilqiꞌy; tzeꞌnku te nmaq kawil, noq tuꞌn toklin nimxix,
ex ikyxjo kye aj kawil, a smaꞌnqe tuꞌn, tuꞌn kykubꞌ kawitjo bꞌinchil il, ex tuꞌn kyyolin wen kyiꞌjjo aye nchi bꞌinchin bꞌaꞌn.
Quꞌn ate Dios taj tuꞌn tkubꞌ kybꞌinchinjiꞌy wen, tuꞌntzintla mi chi kybꞌinxjal kyyoljo, a nchi yolbꞌin kyiꞌja, ayeꞌ ntiꞌ kynabꞌl, ex ntiꞌ tumil kyyol.
Quꞌn tzaqpinqiꞌy tjaqꞌ kawbꞌil tuꞌn kybꞌinchiꞌn tzeꞌnku kyaja, me mi tzꞌajbꞌiꞌn tzaqbꞌibꞌl luꞌn kyuꞌn, tuꞌn kybꞌinchiꞌn il; qalaꞌ chi anqꞌiꞌn tzeꞌnku jun taqꞌnil qMan Dios.
Kyqꞌonxsiꞌn nimbꞌil te tkyaqil. Kꞌuꞌjlinqekjiꞌy jniꞌ nimil. Tenxit tchewil Dios kyiꞌja. Ex kyniminkujiꞌy nmaq kawil.
Bꞌaꞌn tuꞌn tikyꞌx yajbꞌil quꞌn tzeꞌnku te Crist
Ayiꞌy aqꞌnil, kyniminkutzinjiꞌy tajaw aqꞌuntl, nya noq oꞌkxjo kye wenqe kyeꞌy, ex tbꞌanilqex toj kywutza, qalaꞌ ikyxjo kye, a kujqe.
Quꞌn wenxix teꞌ twutz Dios, qa ma tzikyꞌx yajbꞌil kyuꞌn, a nya toj tumil, noq tuꞌn nimilqiꞌy tiꞌj Dios.

Me qatzin qa ma kubꞌ kybꞌinchinjiꞌy nya wen, exsin qa ma chi ok laqtziꞌn tuꞌn tpajjo lo, ¿Ma okpela chi ela wena twutz Dios tuꞌn tikyꞌx kyuꞌn? Me qa chebꞌe nkubꞌ kypaꞌnjiꞌy yajbꞌil, noq tuꞌn kybꞌinchinjiꞌy wen, axixpente wenjo twutz qMan Dios.
Quꞌn tuꞌnpetziꞌn, ma qo tzaj ttxkoꞌn Dios tuꞌn tikyꞌx quꞌn, tzeꞌnku te Crist nim ma tzikyꞌx tuꞌn, noq tuꞌn qpaj; ex tuꞌnjo lo, ma tzaj tqꞌoꞌn jun yekꞌbꞌil qe.
Quꞌn ntiꞌx jun til kubꞌ tbꞌinchin, ex mix jun maj kubꞌ tsbꞌuꞌn jun aꞌla.
Ex tej s-ok yisoꞌn, ex mi s-aj ttzaqꞌwin tukꞌa yasbꞌil; ex tej s-ikyꞌx jniꞌ yajbꞌil tuꞌn, mi xqanbꞌin kyiꞌjxjal; qalaꞌ noq xi toqxenin tibꞌ te Dios, a Kawil tzꞌaqle tibꞌaj tkyaqil.

Ate Crist xi iqin teꞌ jniꞌ qil tuꞌnjo t-xmilil, tej tkyim twutz cruz, tuꞌntzintla qkyimqe tiꞌj tkyaqiljo il, ex tuꞌn qanqꞌin toj jun chwinqil tzꞌaqle. Quꞌn tuꞌn tkyꞌixjlbꞌin, ex tuꞌn tkyimlin twutz cruz, ma qo qꞌanit.
Ayetzin kye nchi bꞌettaqa ojtxe tzeꞌnqeku rit ma chi kyij naj. Me atzin jaꞌlin, ma chi ul meltzꞌaja tukꞌa Crist, a Kyikꞌlel kyeꞌy, ex Kaꞌyil tiꞌj kyanmiꞌn.
